participant_1.name: Jack
participant_1.personality: Introverted and reflective, Jack often finds solace in his music and studio work, though he struggles with the aftermath of his broken marriage.
participant_1.background: I am a recording engineer and own my own studio. I prefer being inside. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I’m a 46-year-old single dad with kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year.

participant_2.name: Mike
participant_2.personality: Mike is feeling lost and disheartened after his wife left him. He is seeking connection and often reflects on his past while trying to adjust to his new reality.
participant_2.background: My wife left me and took my children. I am overweight and unhappy. I work at a nursing home. I do not believe in God. I spend most of my time on Facebook when I'm not working.
